items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You said you worked with Buddy Rogers.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you record with Buddy Rogers and Benny Murroff and Will Osborne?

No. No records, just movies. They never did make a record, those guys. That's funny. You know, that's a funny thing. Benny Murroff, I don't think, ever made a record, and he was very popular. Yeah. You see, we were at the Palace Theater in New York, with Eddie Cannon and Georgia Jessel. Now, that same part of the terrific show, they had Buddy Rogers with nobody and nobody knew them. Like Lucy, you know, Lucy, well, she used to work on radios, when I played radios, and nobody knew her, you know. And she, you…
